source.title: Instructions for Form 8863 (2026 draft)
source.edition: TREASURY/IRS AND OMB USE ONLY DRAFT, 2026

neutral_facts.fact: student born 2004-06-15, single, the filer, enrolled at least half time in a degree program; qualified tuition $5,000 with no scholarship; wages $40,000
neutral_facts.reason: the example gives no income or expenses; the amounts keep the credit unreduced by phaseout and by tax

neutral_facts.fact: the student's earned income exceeds half of the student's own support
neutral_facts.reason: keeps the refundable part from the under-24 student limit (Form 8863 line 7); the example states only the 4-year eligibility

neutral_facts.fact: the filer is not claimed as a dependent and has no felony drug conviction
neutral_facts.reason: the example's other requirements are met

expected.derivation: American opportunity credit 2,500 (100% of the first $2,000 plus 25% of the next $2,000 of expenses), 60% nonrefundable (Form 8863 instructions); the example states eligibility only
40% of the 2,500 American opportunity credit is refundable (Form 8863 line 8)
